CONTROLS.NAME: pusher
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When ON, Percussive hits will cause the the simulation to 'burst'.

CONTROLS.NAME: scroller
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When ON, the actiion is replaced with diagonal scrolling, oscillating on the beat. Leads to interesting contour lines and more 'echoes'.

CONTROLS.NAME: soften
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Removes hard edges, resulting on a softer 'smokey' look.

CONTROLS.NAME: monochrome
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn on for a vertically scrolling stark black and white scene. Good for dramatic parts of the music. Try turning soften and scroller on and off while monochrome is ON.

CONTROLS.NAME: vert_speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Move the simulation twice as fast vertically when ON. Very subtle effect.

CONTROLS.NAME: hor_speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Move the simulation twice as fast horizontally when ON. Very subtle effect.
